description.value: Blue Note Jazz Club is located at 131 West 3rd Street, between MacDougal Street and 6th Avenue, right in the heart of Manhattan’s Greenwich Village in New York City. Everyone needs a ticket to enter the club. Tickets will be e-mailed to customers 48 hours prior to the event. Doors open at 6pm for 8pm shows and 10pm for 10:30pm shows (12:00pm for 1:30pm shown on Sunday Brunches). Upcoming brunch shows include The World Famous Harlem Gospel Choir.
